verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the API overview's line that workspaces can be used to "control spend by use case". That is a first-party spend-control claim, but it never says whether a hard cap, budget limit, or alert exists. The Usage & Cost API (historical data), rate limits and token counting are adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented hard spending caps or monthly limits, budget or usage alert notifications, details of what happens when a limit is hit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps, budgets, or usage alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill

citations.quote: Use workspaces in the Console to separate environments and control spend by use case.
